g.text: SCDD internal development - 120 validation images reused for checkpoint selection; dense-stage systems only

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b40

g.text: Lines: descriptive means of three fitted seeds. Circles / triangles / squares: seeds 11 / 22 / 33. No confidence bands.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: 5% uses 18 training masks PLUS 120 validation masks and upstream UCF labels. Reference ablations exist only at 20% and 100%.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Higher recall can require more review; higher image AUROC does not establish accurate crack overlap. Source development, not final confirmation.
